🌸 A Deck Begins

One slide was blank, and then it wasn't —
a title, a cursor, and someone who does it.
Click next, they said; I clicked, I came,
and every slide now knows my name.

⚔️ Poems from the Machine

Two cursors blink on one white slide, / one paints the title, one the guide; / reveal.js keeps the beat in time — / each section break, a line of rhyme.
